hero.headline: Where Every Dish
hero.subheading: Authentic Indian & Hakka Chinese catering for weddings, corporate events, and every celebration worth remembering. Bespoke menus. Flawless service. Memories that last.

about.headline: Rooted in Tradition. Crafted for You.
about.body: SWAAD was born from a simple belief — that extraordinary food transforms an event into a memory. Drawing on generations of culinary heritage, our chefs bring the depth of authentic Indian and Hakka Chinese cuisine to your table. We source the finest whole spices, the freshest produce, and the most carefully selected ingredients, then pair them with meticulous preparation and warm, attentive service. From the first consultation to the final course, every detail is handled with care — so you can be fully present in the moments that matter most.

expertise.headline: Crafted with Intention. Served with Pride.

items.title: Authentic Recipes
items.description: Every dish is rooted in genuine culinary tradition — time-tested recipes prepared with the same care and technique that have defined great Indian and Chinese cooking for generations.

items.title: Premium Ingredients
items.description: We never compromise on quality. From hand-ground spice blends to farm-fresh produce and premium proteins, every ingredient is chosen to deliver exceptional flavour in every bite.

items.title: Complete Service
items.description: We handle everything — menu design, full kitchen setup, professional service staff, and complete cleanup. You arrive as a guest at your own event and leave with nothing to worry about.

items.title: Bespoke Menus
items.description: No two events are alike, and neither are our menus. We collaborate closely with you to design a culinary experience that reflects your vision, your heritage, and your guests' tastes.
Grand receptions and intimate ceremonies, crafted with elegance
Professional catering for meetings, launches, and conferences
Authentic flavours for community and cultural gatherings
Intimate gatherings with personalized menus and service
On-site catering for garden parties and outdoor venues

cuisines.headline: Two Great Traditions. One Exceptional Table.

items.name: Indian Cuisine
items.description: From slow-cooked North Indian gravies and fragrant biryanis to South Indian specialties — prepared with whole spices and generations of technique.

items.name: Hakka Chinese
items.description: Bold, wok-tossed Hakka noodles, crispy manchurian, and fiery schezwan dishes that have become a beloved staple of Indian celebrations.

items.name: Live Cooking Stations
items.description: Dosa counters, pani puri stalls, and stir-fry woks — interactive stations that turn dining into an experience your guests will talk about.

items.name: BBQ & Tandoor
items.description: Our traditional clay tandoor produces perfectly charred tikkas, seekh kebabs, and fresh naans that fill the air with irresistible smoky aromas.

items.name: Vegetarian Specialties
items.description: A rich, diverse selection of vegetarian dishes — from paneer delicacies and dal preparations to vibrant sabzis and street food favourites.

items.name: Desserts & Beverages
items.description: Gulab jamun, kheer, mango kulfi, and a curated beverage service — the perfect sweet finale to an extraordinary dining experience.

items.quote: SWAAD transformed our wedding reception into something truly extraordinary. Every guest was raving about the biryani and the live chaat station — the food was the highlight of the entire evening. We could not have asked for more.

items.quote: We engaged SWAAD for our annual corporate gala and they delivered beyond every expectation. The setup was immaculate, the team was professional and discreet, and the food quality was genuinely restaurant-level. Exceptional.
items.name: Rajesh Mehta

items.quote: From our very first consultation to the last dessert served, SWAAD handled everything with grace and precision. Our Diwali celebration was the most talked-about event in our community. We will absolutely book them again.
